name: veristack
description: Deterministic 9-rung zero-defect verification ladder, cross-language static and invariant analyzer, Bend 2 formal laws, and anti-cheat CI gates for TypeScript, C#, Rust, Python, Go, SQL, and Shell.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.mjs --target node --external oxc-parser --external smol-toml --external yaml && bun build packages/core/src/index.ts --outfile dist/core.mjs --target node --external oxc-parser --external smol-toml --external yaml && bun build packages/plugin/src/index.ts --outfile dist/plugin.mjs --target node --external oxc-parser --external smol-toml --external yaml
scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path templates/rust-reference/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path templates/rust-reference/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path templates/rust-reference/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:go: cd templates/go-reference && go vet ./... && go test -race -v ./...
scripts.test:python: uv run --project templates/python-reference ruff check templates/python-reference examples/python/clean && uv run --project templates/python-reference ruff format --check templates/python-reference examples/python/clean && uv run --project templates/python-reference mypy templates/python-reference/src templates/python-reference/tests examples/python/clean && PYTHONPATH=examples/python/clean uv run --project templates/python-reference pytest templates/python-reference examples/python/clean
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint:oxlint && bun run check:max-lines && bun run perf:check && bun run lint:no-comments && bun run lint:state-machines && bun src/cli.ts formal-sync . --fail && bun src/cli.ts laws . --fail && bun src/cli.ts perimeter . --fail && bun src/cli.ts verify . --strict
